# Stories

Stories are the pages that organize the photo book into chapter-like sections. Each story is one or more pages of text that has been saved as a PDF file.

## Events: The Key to Organization

Each story PDF is given a name that is the same as a name used for an Event in the photo EXIF data.

The story page will be at the start of a section in the photo book. It's like a chapter. All the photos that have the Event with a value that's the same as the name of the story page will be placed after the story page.

Events categorize the photos. Story pages share the Event name and are used to provide an overview that introduces the photos.
